dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That doesn't sound right to me though.

dialogues.speaker: Vyazemsky
dialogues.text: Of course not. Especially when the one lining their pockets ain't me. That makes it all the worse.

dialogues.speaker: Vyazemsky
dialogues.text: ...*Sigh* Still, maybe that guy will end up getting burned by it one of these days. Dirty money always brings trouble down on your head. It's just a matter of time.
